global_transaction_principle: Any qualified customer. Any supported market. One digital workflow.
north_star: From any legitimate lead in the world to a completed paid digital service with minimal human friction.
invariants: The control plane composes source evidence and must not create a second source of truth
Only an allowed state-graph edge may be considered for transition
Required dependency readiness never substitutes for required transition evidence
Advisory modules must never become implicit authority to advance a hard lifecycle state
Required human authority must be explicit and auditable
Duplicate or replayed idempotency keys must not create a second transition
Unknown stale missing or contradictory hard-gate evidence returns HOLD
Material scope change requires approved Change Request before changed-scope build continues
A payment redirect is not authoritative payment reconciliation
Transition receipts are decision evidence and are not digital signatures payment evidence or Production authority
Production deployment live charging destructive data actions and privilege elevation remain separate HUMAN_ONLY authorities
